name: image_perturbation_load_images
description: Index microscopy TIFF/OME-TIFF filesets, BigTIFF, CZI, ND2, LIF, PNG/JPEG/BMP and local or anonymous remote OME-Zarr 0.4/0.5. Preserve axes, channels, scales and explicit scene/series/level selections. Returns JSONL index and reference, not pixels. Native backends are optional. Remote references verify metadata only, not pixel content. No segmentation or prediction.

source.description: Local image, vendor file, OME fileset entry, local store, manifest, or anonymous OME-Zarr URL (remote mode).

source_type.description: file, directory or manifest for local sources; remote for one anonymous HTTP(S)/S3 OME-Zarr image.

output_dir.description: Directory for image index and dataset reference.

dataset_id.description: Unique dataset ID; generated if omitted.

format.description: Default auto; applies to image files, not manifest table format.

file_pattern.description: Directory glob, default top-level supported raster files and OME-Zarr stores; recursive patterns exclude store internals.

image_root.description: Root for manifest relative image paths; default manifest directory.

image_path_columns.description: Manifest wide channel name to path-column mapping. Each row represents one field.

metadata_column_map.description: Standard metadata field to manifest column name.

field_keys.description: Mapped metadata fields that uniquely identify each manifest row; otherwise row index is used.

missing_images.description: Default error; explicit skip_field skips entire incomplete fields and reports count.

axes.description: Explicit axis order from TCZYX; required if TIFF axes are ambiguous.

channel_map.description: Internal zero-based channel index to name. Must cover every channel; incompatible with manifest channel names.

lazy.description: Default true indexes metadata without pixel decoding. False decodes one selected TIFF series/level, or OME-Zarr chunks sequentially.

series_index.description: Zero-based TIFF series or OME-Zarr multiscales index. Required when more than one series exists.

resolution_level.description: Zero-based pyramid resolution, default zero (full resolution).

group_path.description: OME-Zarr image group inside source store (e.g. A/1/0); default root. No path traversal.

position_index.description: Zero-based mosaic position for LIF; required when the selected image has multiple positions.

remote_timeout.description: Remote request timeout in seconds, default 30; remote mode only.

remote_endpoint.description: Optional anonymous S3-compatible endpoint URL, e.g. https://uk1s3.embassy.ebi.ac.uk. s3 remote mode only; no embedded credentials or query.
